payload.title: GPT-OSS Blackwell Performance Optimization: Pushing the Pareto Frontier
payload.summary: Systematic optimization of gpt-oss-120b (native MXFP4 MoE model) on NVIDIA B200/GB200 through deep vLLM + FlashInfer integration, achieving +38% max throughput and +13% lowest latency across the entire Pareto curve.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.gist: Optimizing a single metric (maximum throughput or minimum batch latency) is often insufficient for real deployments.

sections.heading: 3. Runtime Improvements
sections.gist: Blackwell GPUs are so fast that the CPU (host) becomes the bottleneck, manifesting as inter-kernel gaps.

sections.heading: 4. Deployment Tuning

sections.heading: 5. Results and Next Steps
sections.gist: Since InferenceMax release: **max throughput +38%, lowest latency +13%**, covering the entire Pareto curve.

sections.heading: 6. Notes
